title: Wayback history
description: The URLs dataset and the run summary.

dataset.title: URLs
dataset.description: One row per URL. Paid rows carry firstSnapshotAt, lastSnapshotAt, versionsReturned, capturesRead and latestVersions with billable true; every other row is a free status row with a reason and no history. Status rows are written in batches of up to 100, so sort by actorIndex to get the input order back.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters of the run: requested, attempted, delivered, chargedEvents, deliveredUncharged, deliveredUnverified, chargeUncertain, urlsNotFound, urlsInvalid, cutByLimit, byStatus, counterMismatch, stopReason, datasetNote, firstFailure and priceNote. The bare RUN_SUMMARY lives in the default store of the run; a copy under RUN_SUMMARY-<runId> is kept in the named store wayback-machine-summary so two runs do not overwrite each other.
